summary: A web or mobile user interface: SPA, SSR/SSG site, micro-frontend or app.

routes-screens.must: Every route/page: path, screen/component, purpose, who can access it (guards, roles), data it loads.

state-data.must: State management (store, context, signals), data fetching and caching (query library, revalidation, SSR/SSG), forms and validation, offline/persistence.

backend-apis.must: Every backend called: what for, client/module that calls it, auth, base URL per environment, error handling shown to the user.

ui-system.must: Component library/design system, styling approach, accessibility practices and known gaps, internationalisation (languages, how strings are managed), responsive/browser support.

configuration.must: Build-time and runtime configuration per environment (env files, public env prefixes like VITE_/NEXT_PUBLIC_/REACT_APP_, environment.ts files, runtime config endpoints): which values are public by construction, which must never be put there, who provides each.

deploy.must: Build command and output, hosting (CDN/static host/container/app store), environments, cache invalidation, feature flags, rollback, post-deploy smoke checks.

security.must: Authentication flow (OIDC/redirects/tokens), where tokens are stored, route guards, CSP and headers, secrets that must never reach the bundle, PII shown on screen, plaintext credentials found (paths only).

observability.must: Error tracking, analytics/telemetry events, performance monitoring (Core Web Vitals), logs, how to find a user's session when investigating.
